post.title: feat(metrics): validate capability evidence and derive cross-layer delivery reports
post.body:
## Why

The mission spans the standalone CLI, staging gateway, production bridge/edge and canonical plugin. Existing roadmap totals overlap, while earlier source claims mixed partial code, tests, merges and deployment. This adds a checkable evidence register and readable derived report under #255.

## Changes

- Map143 product requirements to all272 feature bullets and488 total mission bullets; retain11 separate governance groups and concrete GitHub acceptance owners.
- Preserve separate CLI300/DCP48/WEB12/AUG117 baselines and the existing CLI stage/weight snapshot.
- Validate IDs, source/catalog/issue references, exact mission coverage, dependencies, repository/layer ownership, immutable evidence identities and the six required platform/fast/isolation checks.
- Require full-scope source/environment/criteria-bound receipts before any whole-requirement credit. Keep partial source and component delivery visible separately.
- Pin consumed research and saved-main receipt bytes. Reject unknown delivery labels, unaccepted final prerequisites and stale generated outputs.
- Run the register check in normal build/check/package gates; include its inputs and outputs in explicit reviewed-source freshness.

## Original candidate evidence (superseded)

Original candidate: `d61d280c371a66578c4a93aa1df50907c0424347`; tree: `da030a4d25c68efa6cd4c9faa203ff4266fa730f`; base: `4fb205088e77731e42da5adaca6bf167f8b75194`.

**25/25 focused tests passed** (19 capability +6 existing roadmap), with actual RED evidence preceding implementation and later binding fixes. Normal build, typecheck, complete format check, roadmap review/render/check and parity checks passed. Independent evolving-tree review verified the crosswalk, baseline hashes and pinned source mappings, and exposed repaired attribution/check/evidence defects. At original publication, immutable review and hosted checks were pending. That candidate subsequently failed the packaging fixture tests; the repaired candidate and successful qualification are recorded below.

Current report records115 rows with partial source,84 with partial original-baseline components and19 referencing subsequently qualified modernization components. These counts overlap. It grants zero whole-mission acceptance and no composite maturity percentage. CLI300 remains29.36% with0 complete. Source qualification is distinct from deployment; the offline validator checks coherence, not behavioral truth or authenticity.

The profile foundation is already merged in PR #256; this register retains both its earlier package-harness failure and corrected candidate evidence. Its main checks were pending at this snapshot. Issue #255 remains open until its scope is reviewed against the completed delivery. No production, credentials, Access policy, shared Worker or canonical plugin was changed.


## Revised candidate qualification

Independent immutable review approved `b0348d901b27975789d8764397a103204e08aaf0` (tree `cbb3b682c4bfdf472bdfbc1ebfce5cd2e71174fc`). All six required checks passed: [fast CI](https://github.com/MulattoTech/MTerm-CLI/actions/runs/43279988914) and [platform/package/native qualification](https://github.com/MulattoTech/MTerm-CLI/actions/runs/43279988939). Windows source tests: 1,395 passed, no skips/failures; other lanes: 1,383 passed and 12 existing Windows-only skips. All five package lanes passed the 24 installed-profile cases. Native source and installed packages each passed all 12 containment/cleanup scenarios. All four platforms passed real Codex registration/shutdown with zero model calls.

Original candidate `d61d280` failed five source-test jobs because the offline prepack fixture omitted the new capability gate. The revised fixture executes that gate and proves it blocks compilation/packaging on failure; the actual RED and 32/32 focused GREEN evidence are committed. No gate was waived. Actual-main qualification follows the normal merge; deployment and whole-requirement acceptance remain separate.

## Merge request status — 2026-11-12

The normal expected-head merge request timed out. After a fresh authoritative identity read, one retry returned **405: Merge already in progress**. Subsequent independent PR and main-ref reads still show this PR open/unmerged and main at `4fb205088e77731e42da5adaca6bf167f8b75194` as of **19:29 UTC**. Candidate review and all six candidate checks remain passed, but no merge or actual-main qualification is claimed. Further merge retries are held while completion is uncertain; independent engineering continues. Issue255 remains open pending actual main verification.
